content.title: All the Details of Justin Bieber’s Coachella Performance, and How to Watch
content.text: This article contains affiliate links; if you click such a link and make a purchase, we may earn a commission.How to Watch Justin Bieber’s Coachella PerformanceKevin Mazur - Getty Images (Kevin Mazur - Getty Images)Saturday night was one for the Beliebers during the first weekend of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.Late on April 11, Justin Bieber held his first-ever headlining gig at the festival in Indio, California, where he wove through a medley of hits, including some old and new, for a sizable crowd that reportedly extended all the way back to the iconic ferris wheel on the sprawling festival grounds.To kick things off, Bieber crooned a number of songs from his 2025 sister albums, Swagand Swag II, including tracks like “All I Can Take,” “Butterflies,” “Speed Demon,” and “First Place.”Justin Bieber performs on weekend one of the Coachella music festival.Kevin Mazur - Getty Images (Kevin Mazur - Getty Images)Then, the pop singer turned his set into a makeshift “music video night,” pulling up YouTube on a laptop and singing along to fan favorites from some of his earliest albums, including “Baby,” “Favorite Girl,” and “That Should Be Me.”He even searched clips from before his ascent to stardom, performing alongside videos of himself as a tween, singing songs like Ne-Yo’s “So Sick” and “With You” by Chris Brown. (He wasn’t afraid to poke a little fun at himself either, playing clips that saw him falling on stage at a concert and running into a glass door.)During the set, the Grammy winner brought out a few surprise guests, including Dijon, Tems, Mk.gee, Wizkid, and the Kid Laroi. In the audience, his wife, Hailey, danced alongside fans in the crowd.If you’re looking to check out clips from the performance, the official Coachella YouTube account typically uploads videos around 24 hours after the set has taken place (keep checking back here for more updates as videos arrive). In the meantime, you can watch various clips from the performance below.Justin Bieber and Laroi performing STAY together THE VOCALS THE ENERGY THE CROWD EVERYTHING IS INSANE https://t.co/Ocq2cmEMTp— jdb.
